title: Checkout rebuild — acceptance pass
subtitle: Four flows, before we open it to real payments
intro: Work through each flow on the staging build. **A note matters more than a verdict** — if something is off, say what you saw rather than grading it. Anything missing from this list, add it at the bottom.

createdBy.note: Derived from the acceptance criteria in issue #218.

options.label: Partially works
options.hint: Completes, but not the way it should

sections.label: The path most people take
sections.description: If any of these are wrong, nothing below matters.

sections.label: Where it usually breaks
sections.description: Declines, timeouts, and the back button.

nodes.label: Says why the card was declined
Back pressed: charged once at most

items.title: A guest can buy without creating an account
items.body: Add one item, check out without signing in, pay with a test card.

fields.expect: Order confirmed, receipt emailed, no account created.
fields.watch: A sign-in prompt appearing anywhere in the flow.

items.title: A returning customer can pay with a saved card

fields.expect: Card shown masked, one tap to pay.

items.title: A declined card explains itself
items.body: Use the test card that always declines.

fields.expect: Plain-language reason, cart intact, retry without re-entering the address.
fields.watch: A raw gateway error code reaching the customer.

items.title: The back button mid-payment does not double-charge

fields.expect: One charge, one order, whatever the customer does.
